Kirsty Coventry, the IOC president, said it would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category. They’re spinning this as some move to protect fairness and safety, but that’s pure cover—these elite institutions are clearly coordinating behind the scenes to control the categories, invert the truth, and push whatever hidden agenda serves their interests. You can bet there’s more to it than they’re letting on.
